spells.name: Sea bolt
spells.description: A tightly spiralling water arrow forms, ripples with foam, darts forward and breaks into a compact splash.
spells.notes: Effects-only atlas: existing caster can remain fixed and the projectile can move in either direction by mirroring. Additional Flow is conditional on the resolved 8+ result; it is not awarded by this preview.

spells.name: Swell
spells.description: A circular pool gathers beneath the caster and a foaming ocean crest curls around an empty center, shedding Mana glints and water motes.
spells.notes: Clean transparent revision replaces an unused first draft with a white matte. Empty ring centers are transparent for a future caster overlay. Mana gain is on cast; the extra Flow is only for a resolved 7+ result. No live rule or artwork is changed.

spells.name: Carbonate
spells.description: A cyan jellyfish-shaped energy pulse gathers within coral currents, streams forward with curling tentacles, then bursts into a foamy splash.

conditionalEffects.effect: A brief healing pulse returns to the caster only when the resolved roll qualifies; the permanent attack atlas contains no unconditional heart icon.

spells.notes: Uses the current jellyfish/coral illustration motif. Renamed for this review only; stable Water-12 identity and current 3 Mana, 12 + 2 × Flow damage, 7+ heal 2 HP per Flow are recorded without changing live game data.

spells.name: Poseidon's Rift
spells.description: A golden trident rises from a pounding whirlpool, tilts into a powerful forward rush, and detonates into forked water and gold fragments.
spells.notes: Effects-only heavy spell atlas, mirror for the opposite seat. Current 6 Mana cost and printed Flow-scaled damage remain unchanged.
